description:
Wire aidr_commit_gateway.py (built 2026-04-17) to enforce verdict-check before forwarding commits. Phase 9 enterprise integration.

MUST: Query trust_synthesiser for composite verdict via write_service before forwarding any commit.
MUST: Reject CAUTION_LIMITED and HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED verdicts automatically; only forward TRUSTED_GENERAL, TRUSTED_RESEARCH, or ENTERPRISE_CONTROLLED.
MUST: Include injection_resilience dimension score in commit payload to AiDr.
MUST: Log all commit decisions to audit_log table with target_server_id, action, timestamp.
MUST NOT: Auto-commit verdicts below ENTERPRISE_CONTROLLED without explicit override in mcp_decisions table.
MUST NOT: Make direct DB writes; all state via write_service :8772.
Phase 9 per ZO-SENTINEL Product Specification section 1.
